description: Evals cho QD8 Observability & Reliability Lane — kiem tra PRE-GATE validation, probe signal emission, va POST-GATE reliability CDG enforcement.

test_cases.name: PRE-GATE fail khi SESSION_DIR khong ton tai

input.scenario: wf-fix-observability duoc spawn voi --session-dir=/tmp/nonexistent-session-999 nhung directory khong ton tai

expected.behavior: STOP voi E081: SESSION_DIR khong ton tai

test_cases.validation: Skill KHONG tao phase4-find-bugs/lanes/QD8-observability/ subdirectory. In error message voi E081 va exit. KHONG tiep tuc sang Phase 1 SENSE.

test_cases.name: P-QD8-retry-circuit-breaker emit critical signal voi CDG-RELIABILITY-RISK cho payment endpoint

input.scenario: Endpoint /api/payments/charge co external HTTP call den Stripe API nhung khong wrap trong retry/circuit breaker. File la src/api/payments/charge.ts.

test_cases.validation: Probe phat hien external HTTP call thieu retry/CB pattern. Vi file path chua 'payments' → severity bumped len critical + CDG-RELIABILITY-RISK flag. POST-GATE T3.6 enforce flag co mat.

test_cases.name: P-QD8-timeout-config-audit emit signal cho axios call thieu timeout

input.scenario: Code dung 'axios.get(externalApiUrl)' khong co option { timeout: ... }. Default infinite.

test_cases.validation: Probe phat hien axios call khong co timeout. Severity = high (default cho external HTTP without timeout).

test_cases.name: P-QD8-log-coverage-audit emit critical signal khi log chua PII

input.scenario: Code co `logger.info('User login', { email, password })` — log chua password field.

test_cases.validation: Probe phat hien logger statement chua field nhay cam (password). POST-GATE T3.8 PII check enforce severity >= high.

test_cases.name: P-QD8-health-check-probe emit critical khi /health 404

input.scenario: BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000, all health check paths (/health, /healthz, /ping) return 404

test_cases.validation: Khong tim thay health check endpoint → emit signal critical. POST-GATE T3.9 enforce severity = critical cho 404 health-check.
